note: SYNTHETIC: hand-authored stand-in for provider responses, not a recording. It exercises the harness plumbing (budget ledger, routes, compile, checks, review/judge parsing) at $0. Its scores say nothing about real model quality.
idea: Golden Gate Bridge suspension span, two towers and cables

research.reasoning: Used the bridge district statistics for span lengths and tower height.

searches.query: Golden Gate Bridge suspension span main span side span tower height statistics

uncertainties: Deck width (90 ft) sets the depth; at this scale it rounds to about one stud.
sheet.subject: Golden Gate Bridge suspension span
sheet.summary: The 6,450 ft suspension portion: a 4,200 ft main span between two towers and two 1,125 ft side spans, measured without approaches.
sheet.proportions: Main span about 3.73 times each side span; towers 746 ft above water, deck about 220 ft above water.
silhouette: Two tall towers with a deep catenary between them
Side spans much shorter than the main span
distinctive: Art Deco tower setbacks with recessed vertical ribbing
Two main cables passing over the tower tops
Vertical suspender ropes at regular intervals
sheet.hero: Broadside view from the east with both towers.
sheet.layout: x runs north (left) to south (right); +z faces the bay (front).

design.reasoning: Target depth is 1 stud; towers need two legs so the deck is 4 studs. Cables as stepped leans in two planes.

scene.d: The Golden Gate suspension span: two red towers with portal struts, main cables stepping down to mid-span in two planes, hangers and a continuous deck between gray anchorages.
f: Side spans about a quarter of the main span

review.reasoning: Checked spans against the statistics in the sheet.

revision.evidence: No revision was requested for this first build.

composition.evidence: Suspension span only, two towers, anchorages at each end; no approaches or scenery.

review.summary: Two red towers carry stepped main cables over a continuous deck; spans read in the right ratio. Hangers are sparse and the towers are posts rather than Art Deco frames.

Two main towers.evidence: Two red towers at x14 and x64 (views 1, 2).

Two main suspension cables.evidence: Two cable planes in the overhead view.

Vertical hangers.evidence: Only four hangers per plane are visible.

Main cables sagging to mid-span.evidence: Cables meet the deck near x40.

improvements: Hangers: add evenly spaced vertical hangers along the main span.
Towers: widen the legs and add stepped setbacks so they read as Art Deco towers.

Cables and roadway remain distinct.evidence: Cables rise above the deck except at mid-span.

Tower height above road is not confused.evidence: Deck at 7-9 plates, tower tops at 25 plates above the water base.

judge.summary: Proportions right; tower detail and hangers missing.
